en: This is a sepia-toned image showing a large outdoor gathering of people, most of whom are seated at tables, possibly attending a formal event or celebration. The crowd appears to be dressed in early 20th-century attire, with many men wearing hats and suits and women in dresses and hats. The background features trees, a white wall, and what appears to be a structure or a gazebo partially draped in fabric or foliage.
